build_rust: Rust compiles the native core: creates a binary that talks directly to the OS and attaches the system WebView.

err_matrix_singular: Matrix {mat} is singular and cannot be inverted.
err_matrix_add_dim: For addition, both matrices must have the same dimensions! A is {rowsA}×{colsA}, B is {rowsB}×{colsB}.
err_matrix_sub_dim: For subtraction, both matrices must have the same dimensions! A is {rowsA}×{colsA}, B is {rowsB}×{colsB}.
err_matrix_mul_dim: For A × B multiplication, columns of A ({colsA}) must equal rows of B ({rowsB})!
err_matrix_mul_ba_dim: For B × A multiplication, columns of B ({colsB}) must equal rows of A ({rowsA})!
matrix_calculator_desc: Configurable dimensions for matrices A (M × K) and B (K × N) from 1×1 to 6×6, A×B and B×A products, inverses, and determinants.
swap_matrices: Swap Matrix A and Matrix B
statistics_tool_desc: Compute arithmetic mean, median, variance, standard deviations, and IQR quartiles.
data_sample_label: Data sample (separated by commas, spaces, or newlines)
enter_at_least_one_number: Enter at least one number to compute statistics.
unknown_element_hint: Unknown element: "{sym}". Check capitalization (e.g. "Na" instead of "NA").
confirm_clear_past_events: Are you sure you want to delete all events before today?
export_ical_desc: Export all events to standard iCalendar (.ics) format
search_events: Search event by title or description…
color_palette_desc: Generate harmonious color palettes, convert HEX/RGB/HSL/CMYK, and verify WCAG 2.1 accessibility (AA/AAA).
mock_desc: This text simulates real app content. Accessibility ensures users with visual impairments and lower-contrast displays can read comfortably without eye strain.
wcag_ui_requirement: Required for button borders, form inputs, and chart elements.
translator_initial_input: This document was securely converted in a local application.
translator_initial_output: This document was securely converted in a local application.
hybrid_offline_note: Hybrid architecture demo — online tool is safely locked while in offline mode.
offline_translator_explanation: The translation engine requires an external cloud API. Because you are offline, this module is paused.
online_translator_desc: Translation utility with instant phrase lookup and preview.
password_gen_desc: Cryptographically secure random password generation (CSPRNG) and memorable passphrases.
pomodoro_timer_desc: Productive Pomodoro technique with sound alerts, precision countdown timer, and lap stopwatch.
qr_code_desc: Instant offline QR code generation for URLs, Wi-Fi networks, and text with PNG export.
qr_offline_note: QR code is generated locally in real time without calling external servers or APIs.
tool_system_monitor_desc_web: Browser performance monitoring via Web APIs (Performance API, Storage API, rAF timing). Some metrics are approximations.
sys_telemetry_desc: How OmniDesk bridges `@tauri-apps/plugin-os` and the Rust `sysinfo` crate for sub-20ms telemetry without Electron overhead.
time_pomodoro_desc: World clock for global teams and focused Pomodoro productivity timer.
world_timezones_desc: World clock for global cities with an interactive time slider for scheduling international calls and meetings.
